_comment: Local doc-form config. Read by BOTH doc-guard.ps1 (hook) and Check-DocForm.ps1 (census) - the single source, so the two enforcers cannot drift. Birth-time file: fill pathMarker and budgets at instantiation; the four ceiling values are framework defaults, retune only under a recorded decision. Keys under budgets are repo-relative POSIX paths (forward slashes).
